import re, collections
product_id = 1570
# Fetch ALL verified product reviews (no keyword query) to ensure we capture all battery-life mentions
all_reviews = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.amazon.show_product_reviews(product_id=product_id, is_verified=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(res, dict) and 'reviews' in res:
        page_items = res['reviews']
    else:
        page_items = res if isinstance(res, list) else []
    print('reviews page', page_index, 'count', len(page_items))
    if not page_items:
        break
    all_reviews.extend(page_items)
    page_index += 1

print('total_verified_reviews', len(all_reviews))
# Extract hours-like numbers from each review text
hour_values = []
review_hour_mentions = []
for r in all_reviews:
    text = r.get('text','') or ''
    # capture patterns like '31 hours', '10 hrs', '8.5 hours'
    vals = re.findall(r'(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:hours?|hrs?|hr)\b', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    # also capture 'Lasts 31 hours'
    if vals:
        hour_values.extend([float(v) for v in vals])
        review_hour_mentions.append((r.get('review_id'), vals, r.get('title',''), r.get('created_at','')))

print('reviews with hour mentions', len(review_hour_mentions))
print('hour_values_from_reviews', hour_values)
for item in review_hour_mentions:
    print('review_id', item[0], 'vals', item[1], 'title', item[2], 'created_at', item[3])

# Use existing all_reviews if present; otherwise fetch verified reviews for product 1570.

if 'all_reviews' not in globals() or not all_reviews:
    all_reviews=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res=apis.amazon.show_product_reviews(product_id=product_id, is_verified=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        page_items = res.get('reviews',[]) if isinstance(res, dict) else (res if isinstance(res, list) else [])
        print('fetch page', page_index, 'count', len(page_items))
        if not page_items:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(page_items)
        page_index += 1

    matches=re.findall(r'(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:hours?|hrs?|hr)\b', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

        vals.append(float(m))
print('verified_review_count', len(all_reviews))
